desc: Verify the invariant: operation on pieces i..i+3 swaps gaps g_i and g_{i+2}; parity classes permute arbitrarily; confirmed with samples.
Prove/justify minimality: sum = N*X_1 + Σ (N−k)*g_k; weights decrease in k; sort gaps ascending within each parity class (rearrangement inequality).
Edge cases: N=4, coordinates up to 1e12 (Python int), N up to 2e5 (O(N log N)).
Validate against both samples mentally (21 and 41 both reproduced).

Write final Python solution with fast I/O: parse stdin, compute gaps, split by 0-indexed parity, sort each class ascending, place back at ascending positions of that parity, compute answer with weight (N−1−j), print.
